ἡδύν: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc. acc. sg.
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἰάπτῃ: ἰάπτω — assail, hurt, mar; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose/result clause with ὡς ἄν
ἰούσης: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. gen. sg., genitive absolute: ’as the ship went’
ἰόντι: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’for you, going’
ἱερὴ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. nom. sg.

ἴαχε: ἰάχω — cry out, resound, roar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, of a loud natural noise
ἴκμενον: ἴκμενος — favorable, following (of a wind); masc. acc. sg., in the formula ἴκμενον οὖρον
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl. (hortatory): ’let us go’
ἴσθι: οἶδα — know; perf. imper. 2 sg.: ’know (it)!’ · also εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’be!’ (the two forms are identical; context here favors οἶδα)
ἴχνια: ἴχνιον — footprint, track; neut. acc. pl.
ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
ἵεται: ἵημι — send; mid. hasten, be eager, press on; pres. 3 sg.
ὀιομένη: ὀίομαι — suppose, think, expect; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ὀλέσσῃ: ὄλλυμι — destroy, kill; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -εσσ-, in a purpose clause
ὀλοφυρομένη: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail, mourn; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ὀπυίοι: ὀπυίω — marry, take to wife (of a man); pres. opt. 3 sg., potential in a relative clause: ’whoever might marry (her)’
ὀτρύνοντος: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., genitive with ἄκουσαν: ’heeded him urging’
ὀφέλλειεν: ὀφέλλω — increase, augment (not to be confused with ὀφείλω ’owe’); opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would increase’
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause
ὁρμήν: ὁρμή — onset, impulse, start; acc. sg., here ’the start, the setting-out’
ὅπλ: ὅπλον — tool, gear; pl. ship’s tackle and rigging (not weapons here); neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅπλ’ = ὅπλα)
ὅπλα: ὅπλον — tool, gear; pl. ship’s tackle and rigging (not weapons here); neut. acc. pl.
ὅπλων: ὅπλον — tool, gear; pl. ship’s tackle and rigging; neut. gen. pl.
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause
ὑπέδεκτο: ὑποδέχομαι — undertake, promise, agree to; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented
ὑπερηνορεόντων: ὑπερηνορέω — play the overbearing man, be overweening (ὑπέρ + ἀνήρ); pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted, partitive with τις
ὤρνυντο: ὄρνυμι — stir, rouse; mid. bestir oneself, rise; impf. 3 pl., + inf.: ’rose (to sleep)’
ὤτρυνεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur; impf. 3 sg.
ᾔτεε: αἰτέω — ask, ask for, request; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted

__broaden__.αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly (of an uncanny likeness); adv. · also general intensifier with a verb of emotion: αἰνῶς ἵεται ’is terribly eager’
__broaden__.αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also intensive, accusative subject of an infinitive: ’she herself’ (αὐτὴν ποθέσαι ’that she herself miss [him]’)
__broaden__.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’)
__broaden__.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for herself’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun referring to a thing, dat. sg. with ἐν: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ, of the ship)
__broaden__.εὐρύκλει: Εὐρύκλεια — Eurycleia, Odysseus’s old nurse; fem. voc. sg., elided (Εὐρύκλει’ = Εὐρύκλεια) · also nom. sg. (identical form), in apposition naming a subject already introduced (’Eurycleia, Ops’ daughter...’), not vocative address
__broaden__.θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., genitive with a verb of hearing · also genitive governed by a preposition (ἄνευ θεοῦ ’without a god’)
__broaden__.θεῖον: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (θεῖον ποτόν ’divine drink’)
__broaden__.κατήλυθον: κατέρχομαι — come down, put in (from the sea); aor. 1 sg. · also aor. 3 pl. (identical form): ’they came down’ (of Telemachus and Athena reaching the ship)
__broaden__.κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’)
__broaden__.μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κῆρα · also agreeing with νῆα (θοὴν ἀνὰ νῆα μέλαιναν ’the swift black ship’)
__broaden__.μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a place-name: ’mid-Argos’ · also as an ordinary attributive adjective agreeing with a neuter noun: ’the middle of the sail’ (μέσον ἱστίον)
__broaden__.μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’)
__broaden__.οἶδ: οἶδα — know; perf. 1 sg., elided (οἶδ’ = οἶδα) · also perf. 3 sg. (identical elided form): ’he/she knows’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ(ε) ’who knows’)
__broaden__.ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’
__broaden__.πρίν: πρίν — before, until; conj./adv., + inf. (like Attic πρίν) · also + a temporal clause (πρίν γ’ ὅτ’ ἄν + subj.): ’until the time when’
__broaden__.τηλεμάχοιο: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο, governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’ (not by κίε) · also plain possessive gen. with a periphrasis (ἱερὴ ἲς Τηλεμάχοιο ’the might of Telemachus’, i.e. Telemachus himself)
__broaden__.φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι)
__broaden__.ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
__broaden__.ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
__broaden__.ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become, happen; aor. 3 sg. used with pres. force: ’is’ · also with ordinary past/aorist force: ’came to be, arose’ (τοῦτο νόημα ἔπλετο ’this thought has arisen’)
__broaden__.ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
__broaden__.ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. __broaden__.ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
__broaden__.ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
